title: Update heading and tile colors to match logo and background

requirements.text: Change all heading colors from green to match the LivSpan logo color tone. Update the gradient utilities in frontend/index.css to use the logo's color palette instead of the current green gradient, and ensure all headings throughout the application use this new color scheme.

quotes: Überschriften nicht in grün sondern im gleichen Farbton wie das Logo gestalten

acceptanceCriteria: All headings use the logo's color tone instead of green
Gradient utilities in CSS are updated to reflect logo colors
Visual consistency is maintained across all dashboard panels and components

requirements.text: Adjust tile (FactorMarker cards) colors to harmonize with the background. Update the FactorMarker component styling to use colors that complement the DNA helix background, ensuring proper contrast while maintaining visual cohesion with the overall theme.

quotes: Kacheln passend zum Hintergrund farblich gestalten

acceptanceCriteria: FactorMarker tiles have colors that harmonize with the DNA helix background
Sufficient contrast is maintained for readability
Hover and selection states remain visually clear

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/components/ui components
Maintain the existing dark mode theme structure
Preserve the OKLCH color system already in use
nonGoals: Modifying the DNA helix animation or structure
Changing the overall layout or component structure
